_comment: Development questions, used only to choose the relevance threshold (evaluate.py, part 2); the test questions in questions.json are never used for that. 'answerable' are the training and validation questions of 02-rag-vs-fine-tuning: other wordings of help-center facts, each with the article it came from. Some cover the same facts as test questions in different words, so dev and test are related, not independent. 'not_in_docs' sound like support questions that the help center doesn't answer: 9 from 02 (source '02') and 10 written for this demo (source 'new'), checked against every article, on topics different from the 6 test questions.
